nodes.description: Deploys the token: sets tax wallet, burn/tax fees, uniswap router, funds contract with reflections, excludes contract and tax wallet from fees, sets initial max tx amount to 4% of supply.
Public ERC20 transfer that routes through _transfer using _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: performs _transfer then decrements the spender allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve that writes the _allowances mapping for msg.sender.
Internal transfer core: enforces max tx amount on buys, triggers contract-token swap and ETH payout to the tax wallet when conditions hold, then performs the reflection transfer.
Internal wrapper delegating the actual balance mutation to _transferStandard.
Applies reflection accounting: subtracts rAmount from sender, adds rTransferAmount to recipient, accrues team fees and reflects the burn/tax fee.
Locked-swap helper that approves the router and calls swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with the current block.timestamp as deadline.
Sends accumulated ETH held by the contract to the tax wallet using a raw transfer.
Tax-collector only: approves the router, creates the Uniswap pair, adds liquidity with the whole contract ETH balance, enables swapping and marks trading open.
Tax-collector only: lowers the tax fee to a value below the initial tax constant.
Tax-collector only: raises the max transaction amount to the whole total supply, disabling the anti-whale limit.
Tax-collector only: manually swaps the contract token balance for ETH.
Tax-collector only: manually sends the entire contract ETH balance to the tax wallet.
Owner only: sets the stored owner address to the zero address, permanently renouncing privileged control.
Returns the stored owner address used in fee-exemption and access checks.
Derives reflection amounts, transfer amounts and fees for a given token amount using the current rate.
Computes the reflection rate as rSupply divided by tSupply.
Reflection balance accounting mapping used to derive real balances.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Mapping of addresses exempted from transfer fees and buy limits.
Total reflections supply, reduced on every reflected fee.
Accumulated token fee total.
Burn/team fee percentage applied on every transfer.
Reflection tax fee percentage, mutable by the tax collector.
Payable address receiving ETH from fee swaps and defining the tax-collector privilege.
Maximum buy amount enforced as an anti-whale limit; removable by the tax collector.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, pair creation and liquidity.
Address of the token/WETH Uniswap pair.
Flag set once trading has been opened by the tax collector.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token swaps during transfers.
Stored owner address of the Ownable base contract.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, owner candidate and tax-collector candidate.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as the uniswap swap deadline, extending transaction validity.
External call into the router performing a token-for-ETH swap with amountOutMin of 0 and deadline of block.timestamp.
External payable call adding liquidity with unrestricted min amounts, sending the contract ETH balance.
Outgoing ETH value transfer to the tax wallet performed inside the transfer flow.
External call creating the Uniswap pair whose returned address is trusted and stored as _pair.
Amount argument supplied by the caller of transfer.
Source address of the internal transfer.
Destination address of the internal transfer.
Token amount being moved in the reflection accounting routine.
New tax percentage supplied by the tax collector.
Token amount approved and swapped for ETH.
ETH amount forwarded to the tax wallet.
Cached token balance of the contract used to size the fee swap.
Contract ETH balance compared against the tax threshold before payout.
Swap path array of [token, WETH] passed to the router.
Computed reflection rate used for balance conversions.
Source address passed into the token transfer wrapper.
Destination address passed into the token transfer wrapper.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the tax wallet and the initial token recipient during construction.
msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when decreasing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance written by approve.
msg.sender flows into the internal transfer as from when called from transfer/transferFrom.
onlyTaxCollector requires _taxWallet == msg.sender before opening trading.
onlyTaxCollector gate on tax rate changes is checked against msg.sender.
onlyTaxCollector gate on removing the buy limit is checked against msg.sender.
onlyTaxCollector gate on manualSwap is checked against msg.sender.
onlyTaxCollector gate on manualSend is checked against msg.sender.
onlyOwner requires _owner == msg.sender before renouncing ownership.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, letting a miner extend transaction validity.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates all work to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates all work to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom reads and reduces the caller allowance stored in _allowances.
approve writes the allowance entry for msg.sender and spender.
_transfer hands off the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates the reflection accounting to _transferStandard.
The anti-whale limit read from _maxTxAmount constrains buy transfers.
Fee-exemption lookups in _isExcludedFromFee bypass the buy limit for privileged recipients.
_inSwap guards against re-entering the fee swap from inside a transfer.
_swapEnabled decides whether automatic fee swapping runs during a transfer.
_pair identifies buy-side transfers subject to the max tx amount.
Transfers to or from the stored owner skip the fee and limit logic.
A qualifying transfer triggers the internal swapTokensForEth call.
When the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold, the transfer path performs an outgoing ETH send whose gas control is delegated to _taxWallet.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call that can execute arbitrary external logic.
The router instance stored in _uniswap is invoked and its WETH address is read.
lockTheSwap sets _inSwap while the swap external call is in flight.
sendETHToFee performs an outgoing ETH value transfer to a stored external address.
The ETH recipient is the mutable tax wallet address.
startTrading calls the factory to create the pair and trusts the returned address.
startTrading forwards the whole contract ETH balance into addLiquidityETH with zero minimums.
The liquidity recipient is resolved from the owner() accessor.
The router is used to query the factory and WETH and to add liquidity.
startTrading flips _canTrade to block repeated initialization.
startTrading enables automatic swapping by setting _swapEnabled.
The pair address returned by createPair is persisted in _pair.
lowerTax writes the new value into the _taxFee state variable.
removeBuyLimit overwrites _maxTxAmount with the whole total supply.
manualSwap invokes the internal swap helper with the full contract balance.
manualSend routes the contract ETH balance through sendETHToFee.
renounceOwnership sets the stored owner address to the zero address.
owner() returns the _owner state variable used by access checks.
_transferStandard derives amounts and fees through _getValues.
_getValues obtains the reflection rate from _getRate.
Sender and recipient reflection balances in _rOwned are mutated.
The reflected fee is subtracted from the _rTotal reflection supply.
Accrued fee tokens are added to _tFeeTotal.
The constructor assigns the whole reflection supply to the contract itself.
The constructor marks the contract and tax wallet as fee exempt.
The constructor initializes the burn fee percentage.
The constructor initializes the tax fee to the initial tax constant.
The constructor stores the deployer as the payable tax wallet.
The constructor sets the initial max tx amount to one twenty-fifth of total supply.
The constructor hardcodes the Uniswap V2 router address.

normalization_plan.reason: The caller-supplied amount exists only as the argument of the public transfer and carries no independent semantic role.
The from parameter is a positional alias for the transfer source handled entirely inside _transfer.
The to parameter is a positional alias for the transfer destination handled entirely inside _transfer.
The token amount parameter is consumed immediately by the reflection accounting routine.
The new tax rate is only meaningful as the guarded argument written into _taxFee.
The swap amount is used solely to approve and swap through the router inside the helper.
The ETH amount is only the value forwarded to the tax wallet by the payout helper.
The cached contract balance exists only to size the fee swap triggered within _transfer.
The cached ETH balance exists only for the threshold comparison that gates the payout in _transfer.
The path array is a transient constructor of the router swap arguments.
The rate local is the direct return value of the rate computation and has no separate meaning.
The sender parameter is merely forwarded to _transferStandard by the wrapper function.
The recipient parameter is merely forwarded to _transferStandard by the wrapper function.
